remedy.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg, Agenturring 6, 65549 Musterlimburg.

items.title: Start of unemployment benefit (Arbeitslosengeld) entitlement
items.quote: ab dem 01.01.2027 erhalten Sie Arbeitslosengeld für 360 Kalendertage.

items.title: Register as unemployed (sich arbeitslos melden)
items.action: Register as unemployed in person or online with the Agentur für Arbeit on your first day of unemployment, if you have not already done so.
items.quote: Melden Sie sich bitte am ersten Tag der Arbeitslosigkeit persönlich oder online arbeitslos, falls noch nicht geschehen.

items.title: Deadline to file an objection (Widerspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with this decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or by having it recorded in person at the Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the decision becomes final (bestandskräftig).
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg, Agenturring 6, 65549 Musterlimburg.

data.tax_note: Unemployment benefit (Arbeitslosengeld) is tax-free itself but must be reported in the annual tax return because it increases the tax rate applied to other income (Progressionsvorbehalt).
data.title: Approval of unemployment benefit (Bewilligung von Arbeitslosengeld)
data.summary: The Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg approved Bastian Musterquell's unemployment benefit (Arbeitslosengeld) of €48.71 per day for 360 calendar days, starting 1 January 2027, based on his earnings at Druckerei Beispiellahn over the last twelve months.
data.explanation: This letter confirms that your unemployment benefit was approved starting 1 January 2027, paying €48.71 per day for up to 360 days. If you haven't already registered as unemployed, do so in person or online on your first day without a job. If you disagree with the amount or duration, you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app will show the exact deadline. If you take no action, the decision stands as issued. Keep this letter for your tax return, since the benefit affects your tax rate even though it's untaxed itself.
